signaling_summary: The A2B line is a differential signal over a single unshielded twisted pair (~100 Ω). The main node drives the bus clock and superframe; each sub node recovers the clock from the line and re-times the signal. DC phantom power (bus power) is delivered on the same conductors as the AC-coupled differential audio/control signal, so a remote node can be powered entirely from the line. A2B is designed for low electromagnetic emissions in the automotive environment. The local node interfaces (I2S/TDM digital audio, I2C control) connect to local codecs / ADC-DAC / amplifiers, whose analog characteristics are separate from the A2B line itself.
